'''Narbuj Desilijic Preor''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At one point, he hired the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Stormtrooper X]] as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. According to the Hutt, X, however, raided one of Narbuj's safehouses and made off with an amount of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] and [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] that weighed the mass of a Hutt. Narbuj eventually posted a 20,000-credit [[Death/Legends|dead]]-or-alive [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the [[Gender/Legends|man]], posted on the [[Imperial Enforcement DataCore/Legends|Imperial Enforcement DataCore]].<ref name="Bounties" />

==Behind the scenes==
Narbuj Desilijic Preor was mentioned in the article "[[Bounties to Die For]]", written by [[S. Mitch Ritchie]] and published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 6|sixth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' released<ref name="Bounties" /> on [[August 14]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20010815.html|text=Hunting Down ''Gamer'' #6}}</ref>
